01 02 03 04 05 06 07 
import type { Artifacts } from 'cloudflare:workers';
interface Env { ARTIFACTS: Artifacts; }
export default { async fetch(request: Request, env: Env) {
  const { remote, token, repo } = await env.ARTIFACTS.create('demo');
  const readToken = await repo.createToken('read', 3600);
  return Response.json({ remote, token: readToken });
} };
